decoded.meaning: SETTINGS{NAME "reliability", VALUE u8=1} — a named-knob SETTINGS record as the library encoder emits one
decoded.note: bytes emitted by the libtracer reference encoder; structurally faithful. NOTE: since RFC-0022 `reliability` is no longer a VERTEX knob — it is bits 0-1 of the per-subscription `delivery_policy` — so this vector pins the SETTINGS record SHAPE, not a `:settings` knob name.
